text_block_list.text:
One day, I happened to run into
Gold Ship inside the school building, and—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: "Gah! That jerk really pisses me off!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Cut the 'what's wrong' crap! Listen to this!
Jordan, that jerk—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm, 'Modern Hot-Spots ☆ Dating Guide'?
Why in the world are you looking at that?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~? You're the last person
I ever wanna hear that line from.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The hell did you say? Are you tryin' to say
I can't even go on a date!?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Totally impossible.
I'd even bet my new nail polish on it.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"—Who the hell d'you think you're messing with?!
Even I can go on dates, dammit!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you're free anyway, right!?
We're going on a date right now, let's freaking gooo!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm gonna show Jordan once and for all!
Going on a date's a piece of cake!

Before I even had time to reply, I was grabbed by the scruff of the neck
and dragged away...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"First, let's go shopping in a stylish town.
Let's get into the mood~♪"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Looks like it.
So, this is our first stop.
Calling it a "stylish district" feels a bit generous, considering how worn down it looks, but—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Looking for something fun—oh?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Look, Trainer! That, over there, look look look!
It's amazing!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Check out that fishmonger over there! They've got some super lively mantis shrimp!
Looks like they're ready to leap right out!

Right from the start, a unique atmosphere settled in.
Just what is going to happen next...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"After shopping, let's relax with tea
at a cafe~♪" That's the plan!
choice_data_list: This is a ramen shop, though...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! Ain't no problem at all! Ramen is basically a drink!
Which means a ramen shop is the same as a cafe!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Pops!
Tonkotsu ramen, extra-firm noodles!

With an exuberant Gold Ship by my side,
our unique date continues.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"If you wrap things up with a walk in the park at night,
you're practically guaranteed to set the right mood♪"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
So with that, let's cap it off with some soccer!
Here I gooo—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Agony and Pandemonium: Transcendent Kickkkk!!!!
[Mental Break Shooooot!!!!]
(Wheeeeeew!!)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: —Hell yeahh!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The ball slid smoothly down the slide!
This match is my win!

It's been a few hours since she dragged me out, saying we're "going on a date."
I'm still not really sure if this qualifies as a date or what, but...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Phew, gotta admit I'm a bit tired.
What are we doing after this?
choice_data_list: I'll go buy us something to drink.
Overtime! We keep going until we win!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look at you being considerate.
Make mine a flat cola.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Haaah... Today was pretty fun.

Whether you'd call it a date or not,
there's no doubt the time we spent together was fun.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I was taking photos of our memories today.
...Mantis shrimp, ramen, and then soccer.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, I'm totally gonna show this off to Jordan tomorrow!
Wonder what she's gonna say~?

I have a feeling you'd tell me
this isn't a date, but...

"Looking at it another way, it might mean the only ones who can share this joy
are the two of us."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right. That 120-shot burst of the mantis shrimp,
I'll send 'em to you later.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The photo turned out super vivid.
Here, thought I'd share it with you.

Late that night—
a burst of 120 vivid mantis shrimp photos arrived.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're all fired up! Love to see it!
Alright, you're up next!

Focusing every nerve, facing the ball.
And then, with body and soul—I kick!!
(—Plop)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOH--!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The ball got stuck right in the slide!
It doesn't look like it's gonna budge at all!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Damn, you're awesome! If you're gonna go that far,
I've got no choice! Today's your win!

I didn't really understand the rules,
but somehow, it left me feeling refreshed.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, we played and played. That was a blast.
Especially soccer.

It started with mantis shrimp in the shopping district, and somehow ended with
grown adults playing some mysterious brand of soccer in a park at night.
It might look a little strange to outsiders, but enjoying the present with everything we've got—that's just our dynamic.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Dates are fun. Let's do it again.
Next time, Crimson Hellfire Soccer.
Nodding at Gold Ship's words, the two of us looked up at the night sky for a while.
